question: What happens to unsent, unacknowledged, and re-sent note operations and meeting lifecycle mutations across connection cuts in the real hooks?

replaced: convex/react (fake client with the same React binding surface)

suites.expectation: baseline: one edit, one acceptance, no duplicates, no divergence

suites.world: cold join with the connection cut before the first query
suites.expectation: isLoading unresolved and content empty until restore

suites.world: server accepted the op; its ack was lost; connection restored
suites.expectation: at-least-once re-send DUPLICATES the op on the server and in the reconciled UI

suites.world: op queued while offline; connection restored before any server contact
suites.expectation: optimistic (consumer) state diverges from saved state while queued; replays exactly once

suites.world: participant removed server-side while the consumer is offline
suites.expectation: op rejected; consumer keeps the optimistic text with no saved/unsaved signal

suites.world: two worlds differing ONLY in server acceptance, compared on the hook's visible state
suites.expectation: the hook's visible state is byte-for-byte identical in both worlds

suites.world: four consecutive cut/restore cycles, one edit per cycle
suites.expectation: duplicates accumulate: every edit is applied twice on the server
baseline: start and end each accepted exactly once

suites.world: server started the meeting; ack lost; connection restored
suites.expectation: isStarting stays true until the late path; re-send duplicates the start acceptance

suites.world: start queued while offline, then navigation away
suites.expectation: meeting never starts; the UI believed it did

suites.world: end queued while offline, then navigation away
suites.expectation: meeting stays active while the user believed it ended; post-call processing never triggered

suites.world: server ended the meeting; ack lost; connection restored
prompt-generation action fires while the connection is down
suites.expectation: action is not replayed; failure is swallowed (console.warn only, error state null)

suites.world: getConnectionInfo called during render with a changing meetingId
suites.expectation: render-phase state update loop, capped by React
